body.en: This chapter is about reading and reshaping graphs algebraically: what a formula tells you about symmetry before you ever plot a point, how shifting/stretching/reflecting a base graph changes its equation, and how to pin down a function's domain from its formula alone.
body.ar: This chapter is about reading and reshaping graphs algebraically: what a الصيغة tells you about symmetry before you ever plot a point, how shifting/stretching/reflecting a base التمثيل البياني changes its المعادلة, and how to pin down a الدالة's المجال from its الصيغة alone.

body.en: Starting from a base function \( f(x) \), the transformed function \( g(x)=a\,f(x-h)+k \) applies, in this order: a horizontal shift by \( h \) (right if \( h>0 \)), a vertical stretch/compression and reflection by \( a \) (a reflection over the \( x \)-axis if \( a<0 \)), and a vertical shift by \( k \).
body.ar: Starting from a base الدالة \( f(x) \), the transformed الدالة \( g(x)=a\,f(x-h)+k \) applies, in this order: a horizontal shift by \( h \) (right if \( h>0 \)), a vertical stretch/compression and reflection by \( a \) (a reflection over the \( x \)-axis if \( a<0 \)), and a vertical shift by \( k \).

Let \( f(x)=x^2 \) and \( g(x)=2f(x-3)+1=2(x-3)^2+1 \). Find \( g(5) \), and describe the transformation from \( f \) to \( g \) in words.

\[ g(5)=2(5-3)^2+1=2(4)+1=9. \]

\( g \) is \( f \) shifted right \( 3 \), stretched vertically by a factor of \( 2 \), and shifted up \( 1 \).

body.en: A function is even if \( f(-x)=f(x) \) for every \( x \) in its domain (graph symmetric about the \( y \)-axis). A function is odd if \( f(-x)=-f(x) \) for every \( x \) (graph symmetric about the origin — a \( 180^\circ \) rotation of itself). Most functions are neither.
body.ar: A الدالة is even if \( f(-x)=f(x) \) for every \( x \) in its المجال (التمثيل البياني symmetric about the \( y \)-axis). A الدالة is odd if \( f(-x)=-f(x) \) for every \( x \) (التمثيل البياني symmetric about the origin — a \( 180^\circ \) rotation of itself). Most الدوال are neither.

label.en: ▲ Theorem 3.1 — Even/odd powers determine even/odd polynomials
label.ar: ▲ مبرهنة 3.1 — Even/odd powers determine even/odd polynomials

body.en: A polynomial made up only of even-degree terms (including a constant) is an even function; a polynomial made up only of odd-degree terms is an odd function.
body.ar: A كثيرة الحدود made up only of even-degree terms (including a الثابت) is an even الدالة; a كثيرة الحدود made up only of odd-degree terms is an odd الدالة.

body.en: If every term has even degree, write \( f(x)=\sum_k a_k x^{2k} \). Then \[ f(-x)=\sum_k a_k(-x)^{2k}=\sum_k a_k\big((-1)^{2k}x^{2k}\big)=\sum_k a_k x^{2k}=f(x) \] since \( (-1)^{2k}=1 \) for every integer \( k \). If every term has odd degree, write \( f(x)=\sum_k a_k x^{2k+1} \); then \( (-1)^{2k+1}=-1 \), so \( f(-x)=\sum_k a_k(-1)x^{2k+1}=-f(x) \). \( \blacksquare \)
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (الدوال المتقدمة والتمثيلات البيانية):

If every term has even degree, write \( f(x)=\sum_k a_k x^{2k} \). Then \[ f(-x)=\sum_k a_k(-x)^{2k}=\sum_k a_k\big((-1)^{2k}x^{2k}\big)=\sum_k a_k x^{2k}=f(x) \] since \( (-1)^{2k}=1 \) for every integer \( k \). If every term has odd degree, write \( f(x)=\sum_k a_k x^{2k+1} \); then \( (-1)^{2k+1}=-1 \), so \( f(-x)=\sum_k a_k(-1)x^{2k+1}=-f(x) \). \( \blacksquare \)

label.en: Worked example 3.B — Classify even, odd, or neither
label.ar: مثال محلول 3.B — Classify even, odd, or neither

body.en:
Classify \( f(x)=x^4-3x^2+2 \) and \( h(x)=x^3-4x \).

\( f \) has only even-degree terms (\( x^4,x^2,\) and the constant \( 2=2x^0 \)), so by Theorem 3.1 it's even. Check: \( f(2)=16-12+2=6 \) and \( f(-2)=16-12+2=6 \) ✓.

\( h \) has only odd-degree terms (\( x^3,\,x \)), so it's odd. Check: \( h(1)=1-4=-3 \) and \( h(-1)=-1+4=3=-h(1) \) ✓.
body.ar:

\( f \) has only even-degree terms (\( x^4,x^2,\) and the الثابت \( 2=2x^0 \)), so by مبرهنة 3.1 it's even. Check: \( f(2)=16-12+2=6 \) and \( f(-2)=16-12+2=6 \) ✓.

\( h \) has only odd-degree terms (\( x^3,\,x \)), so it's odd. Check: \( h(1)=1-4=-3 \) and \( h(-1)=-1+4=3=-h(1) \) ✓.

body.en: Two formula types automatically restrict a function's domain: a square root \( \sqrt{g(x)} \) requires \( g(x)\geq0 \), and a rational expression \( \dfrac{1}{g(x)} \) requires \( g(x)\neq0 \).
body.ar: Two الصيغة types automatically restrict a الدالة's المجال: a square root \( \sqrt{g(x)} \) requires \( g(x)\geq0 \), and a rational expression \( \dfrac{1}{g(x)} \) requires \( g(x)\neq0 \).

body.en:
Find the domain of \( f(x)=\sqrt{x-5} \) and of \( g(x)=\dfrac{1}{x^2-9} \).

For \( f \): need \( x-5\geq0 \), so the domain is \( x\geq5 \).

For \( g \): need \( x^2-9\neq0 \), i.e. \( x\neq\pm3 \). Domain: all reals except \( 3 \) and \( -3 \).
body.ar:
Find the المجال of \( f(x)=\sqrt{x-5} \) and of \( g(x)=\dfrac{1}{x^2-9} \).

For \( f \): need \( x-5\geq0 \), so the المجال is \( x\geq5 \).

For \( g \): need \( x^2-9\neq0 \), i.e. \( x\neq\pm3 \). المجال: all reals except \( 3 \) and \( -3 \).

body.en: A piecewise function is defined by different formulas on different parts of its domain. To evaluate it at a specific input, first identify which piece's condition that input satisfies, then apply only that piece's formula.
body.ar: A piecewise function is defined by different الصيغ on different parts of its المجال. To احسب قيمة it at a specific input, first identify which piece's condition that input satisfies, then apply only that piece's الصيغة.

label.en: Worked example 3.D — Evaluate a piecewise function
label.ar: مثال محلول 3.D — احسب قيمة a piecewise الدالة

body.en:
Let \( p(x)=\begin{cases}-x+1,&x<0\\x^2-2,&x\geq0\end{cases} \). Find \( p(-3) \) and \( p(3) \).

Since \( -3<0 \), use the first piece: \( p(-3)=-(-3)+1=4 \).

Since \( 3\geq0 \), use the second piece: \( p(3)=3^2-2=7 \).
body.ar:

body.en:
Horizontal Shift Sign: \(f(x - h)\) shifts the graph right by \(h\) units, not left. For example, \(y = (x - 3)^2\) has its vertex at \(x = +3\).

Radical Domain: For \(\sqrt{g(x)}\), the domain requires \(g(x) \geq 0\). For \(g(x) = 16 - x^2\), \(16 - x^2 \geq 0 \implies -4 \leq x \leq 4\). Forgetting that the solution is a closed bounded interval is a common trap.

Inverse Function Reflection: The inverse \(f^{-1}(x)\) reflects across the line \(y = x\), which swaps the domain and range: \(\operatorname{dom}(f^{-1}) = \operatorname{range}(f)\).
body.ar:
Horizontal Shift Sign: \(f(x - h)\) shifts the التمثيل البياني right by \(h\) units, not left. For example, \(y = (x - 3)^2\) has its الرأس at \(x = +3\).

Radical المجال: For \(\sqrt{g(x)}\), the المجال requires \(g(x) \geq 0\). For \(g(x) = 16 - x^2\), \(16 - x^2 \geq 0 \implies -4 \leq x \leq 4\). Forgetting that the الحل is a closed bounded interval is a common trap.

Inverse الدالة Reflection: The inverse \(f^{-1}(x)\) reflects across the line \(y = x\), which swaps the المجال and المدى: \(\operatorname{dom}(f^{-1}) = \operatorname{range}(f)\).

question.en: Given \(f(x) = \dfrac{2x + 5}{x - 3}\) for \(x \neq 3\), find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) and state its domain.
question.ar: Given \(f(x) = \dfrac{2x + 5}{x - 3}\) for \(x \neq 3\), أوجد inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) and state its domain.

solution.en:
1. Set \(y = \dfrac{2x + 5}{x - 3}\) and swap \(x\) and \(y\): \[ x = \frac{2y + 5}{y - 3}. \]
2. Multiply by \(y - 3\): \(x(y - 3) = 2y + 5 \implies xy - 3x = 2y + 5\).
3. Collect \(y\) terms: \(xy - 2y = 3x + 5 \implies y(x - 2) = 3x + 5\).
4. Divide by \(x - 2\): \[ f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x + 5}{x - 2}. \]
The domain of \(f^{-1}(x)\) excludes \(x = 2\): \((-\infty, 2) \cup (2, \infty)\). (This matches the range of \(f\), which has horizontal asymptote \(y = 2\)).
solution.ar:
خطوات الحل التفصيلية: 1. Set \(y = \dfrac{2x + 5}{x - 3}\) and swap \(x\) and \(y\): \[ x = \frac{2y + 5}{y - 3}. \]
2. Multiply by \(y - 3\): \(x(y - 3) = 2y + 5 \implies xy - 3x = 2y + 5\).
3. Collect \(y\) terms: \(xy - 2y = 3x + 5 \implies y(x - 2) = 3x + 5\).
4. Divide by \(x - 2\): \[ f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x + 5}{x - 2}. \]
The domain of \(f^{-1}(x)\) excludes \(x = 2\): \((-\infty, 2) \cup (2, \infty)\). (This matches the range of \(f\), which has horizontal asymptote \(y = 2\)).

question.en: [Practice 2 · Easy] Consider the function \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \). What are the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola represented by this function?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Functions & Graphs): [Practice 2 · Easy] Consider the function \( f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 3 \). What are the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola represented by this function?

hints.en: The given function is a quadratic function in the form \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \), where \( a=1 \), \( b=-4 \), and \( c=3 \).
hints.ar: The given function is a quadratic function in the form \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \), حيث \( a=1 \), \( b=-4 \), and \( c=3 \).

hints.en: The x-coordinate of the vertex of a parabola is given by the formula \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). Substituting the values, we get \(x = -\frac{-4}{2(1)} = \frac{4}{2}\).
hints.ar: The x-coordinate of the vertex of a parabola is given بتطبيق formula \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). Substituting the values, we get \(x = -\frac{-4}{2(1)} = \frac{4}{2}\).

hints.en: Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (2, -1).
hints.ar: وبالتالي، the coordinates of the vertex are (2, -1).

solution.en: The given function is a quadratic function in the form \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \), where \( a=1 \), \( b=-4 \), and \( c=3 \). The x-coordinate of the vertex of a parabola is given by the formula \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). Substituting the values, we get \( x = -\frac{-4}{2(1)} = \frac{4}{2} = 2 \). To find the y-coordinate of the vertex, we substitute this x-value back into the function: \( f(2) = (2)^2 - 4(2) + 3 = 4 - 8 + 3 = -1 \). Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (2, -1).

question.en: [Practice 3 · Medium] The graph of the quadratic function \( f(x) = x^2 + bx + c \) is shown below. The graph passes through the point \( (-2, 5) \) and has its vertex at \( (1, -4) \). Determine the value of \( b \).
question.ar: [Practice 3 · Medium] The graph of the quadratic function \( f(x) = x^2 + bx + c \) is shown below. The graph يمر بالنقطة the point \( (-2, 5) \) and has its vertex at \( (1, -4) \). حدّد value of \( b \).

hints.en: The vertex of a parabola given by \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \) is at \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). In this case, \( a = 1 \) and the x-coordinate of the vertex is given as 1. So, \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2(1)} \). This simplifies to \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2} \), which means \( b = -2 \).
hints.ar: The vertex of a parabola given by \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \) is at \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). In this case, \( a = 1 \) and the x-coordinate of the vertex is given as 1. So, \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2(1)} \). This simplإذا كانies to \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2} \), which means \( b = -2 \).

hints.en: Alternatively, we can use the vertex form of a quadratic equation: \( f(x) = a(x-h)^2 + k \), where \( (h, k) \) is the vertex. Here, \( a=1 \) and \( (h, k) = (1, -4) \), so \( f(x) = (x-1)^2 - 4 \). Expanding this, we get \( f(x) = (x^2 - 2x + 1) - 4 = x^2 - 2x - 3 \). Comparing this to \( f(x) = x^2 + bx + c \), we see that \( b = -2 \) and \( c = -3 \).
hints.ar: Alternatively, we can use the vertex form of a quadratic equation: \( f(x) = a(x-h)^2 + k \), حيث \( (h, k) \) is the vertex. Here, \( a=1 \) and \( (h, k) = (1, -4) \), so \( f(x) = (x-1)^2 - 4 \). فكّ المقدارing this, we get \( f(x) = (x^2 - 2x + 1) - 4 = x^2 - 2x - 3 \). Comparing this to \( f(x) = x^2 + bx + c \), we see that \( b = -2 \) and \( c = -3 \).

hints.en: We can verify that the point \((-2, 5)\) lies on this parabola: \(f(-2) = (-2)^2 - 2(-2) - 3 = 4 + 4 - 3\). This confirms our values.

solution.en:
The vertex of a parabola given by \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \) is at \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). In this case, \( a = 1 \) and the x-coordinate of the vertex is given as 1. So, \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2(1)} \). This simplifies to \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2} \), which means \( b = -2 \).

Alternatively, we can use the vertex form of a quadratic equation: \( f(x) = a(x-h)^2 + k \), where \( (h, k) \) is the vertex. Here, \( a=1 \) and \( (h, k) = (1, -4) \), so \( f(x) = (x-1)^2 - 4 \). Expanding this, we get \( f(x) = (x^2 - 2x + 1) - 4 = x^2 - 2x - 3 \). Comparing this to \( f(x) = x^2 + bx + c \), we see that \( b = -2 \) and \( c = -3 \).

We can verify that the point \( (-2, 5) \) lies on this parabola: \( f(-2) = (-2)^2 - 2(-2) - 3 = 4 + 4 - 3 = 5 \). This confirms our values.

Common errors might involve misinterpreting the vertex formula or making sign errors during expansion.
solution.ar:
The vertex of a parabola given by \( f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c \) is at \( x = -\frac{b}{2a} \). In this case, \( a = 1 \) and the x-coordinate of the vertex is given as 1. So, \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2(1)} \). This simplإذا كانies to \( 1 = -\frac{b}{2} \), which means \( b = -2 \).

Alternatively, we can use the vertex form of a quadratic equation: \( f(x) = a(x-h)^2 + k \), حيث \( (h, k) \) is the vertex. Here, \( a=1 \) and \( (h, k) = (1, -4) \), so \( f(x) = (x-1)^2 - 4 \). فكّ المقدارing this, we get \( f(x) = (x^2 - 2x + 1) - 4 = x^2 - 2x - 3 \). Comparing this to \( f(x) = x^2 + bx + c \), we see that \( b = -2 \) and \( c = -3 \).

We can verإذا كانy thعند النقطة \( (-2, 5) \) lies on this parabola: \( f(-2) = (-2)^2 - 2(-2) - 3 = 4 + 4 - 3 = 5 \). This confirms our values.

Common errors might involve misinterpreting the vertex formula or making sign errors during expansion.

question.en: Consider the functions \( f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 5 \) and \( g(x) = -x + 5 \). The graphs of these two functions intersect at two points. Let these points be \( A \) and \( B \). A third function, \( h(x) \), is defined as the difference between the x-coordinates of these intersection points, i.e., \( h(x) = |x_A - x_B| \). What is the value of \( h(x) \)?
question.ar: Consider the functions \( f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 5 \) and \( g(x) = -x + 5 \). The graphs of these two functions intersect at two points. ليكن these points be \( A \) and \( B \). A third function, \( h(x) \), is defined as the dإذا كانference between the x-coordinates of these intersection points, i.e., \( h(x) = |x_A - x_B| \). ما قيمة \( h(x) \)?

hints.en: To find the intersection points of the graphs of \( f(x) \) and \( g(x) \), we set \( f(x) = g(x) \).
hints.ar: To أوجد intersection points of the graphs of \( f(x) \) and \( g(x) \), we set \( f(x) = g(x) \).

hints.en: Rewrite and simplify to obtain: \( x^2 - 6x + 5 = -x + 5 \) Subtract \( -x + 5 \) from both sides: \( x^2 - 6x + 5 - (-x + 5) = 0 \).
hints.ar: أعد كتابة العلاقة وبسّطها للحصول على: \( x^2 - 6x + 5 = -x + 5 \) Subtract \( -x + 5 \) from both sides: \( x^2 - 6x + 5 - (-x + 5) = 0 \).

hints.en: The value of \(h(x)\) is 5, which corresponds to \(\sqrt{25}\).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(h(x)\) ، \(\sqrt{25}\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
To find the intersection points of the graphs of \( f(x) \) and \( g(x) \), we set \( f(x) = g(x) \).

\( x^2 - 6x + 5 = -x + 5 \)

Subtract \( -x + 5 \) from both sides:

\( x^2 - 6x + 5 - (-x + 5) = 0 \)

\( x^2 - 6x + 5 + x - 5 = 0 \)

Combine like terms:

\( x^2 - 5x = 0 \)

Factor out \( x \):

\( x(x - 5) = 0 \)

This gives two possible x-values for the intersection points:

\( x_1 = 0 \)

\( x_2 = 5 \)

Let \( x_A = 0 \) and \( x_B = 5 \) (or vice versa). The problem defines \( h(x) \) as the absolute difference between these x-coordinates: \( h(x) = |x_A - x_B| \).

\( h(x) = |0 - 5| = |-5| = 5 \).

We are asked for the value of \( h(x) \), which is 5. We need to express this value in a form that matches the choices. The choices are given as square roots.

\( \sqrt{16} = 4 \)

\( \sqrt{25} = 5 \)

\( \sqrt{36} = 6 \)

\( \sqrt{49} = 7 \)

The value of \( h(x) \) is 5, which corresponds to \( \sqrt{25} \).

\( h(x) = |0 - 5| = |-5| = 5 \).

We are asked for the value of \( h(x) \), which is 5. We need to express this value in a form that matches the choices. The choices are given as square roots.

The value of \( h(x) \) is 5, which corresponds to \( \sqrt{25} \).

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
